transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

They sent me here from work. I'm an EMT, and... well, at the station, I kept moving the airway bags around. I was putting them into a pattern that I just knew was right, and I was repeating the dispatch numbers out loud while I did it. 

My lieutenant came over and told me to stop, but I wouldn't step away. I couldn't do it, because it felt like the whole ambulance bay would go bad if I broke the sequence. So, they told me I had to come see you.
Did you hear a voice telling you to arrange the bags and repeat the numbers, or was that urge coming from your own thoughts?

No, it wasn't a voice. I didn't hear anyone talking to me. It was just... my own thoughts, I guess. I just knew exactly how they needed to be placed, and the numbers just kind of came out with it. It just felt like something I had to do myself.
At the time, did a part of you feel that moving the bags couldn't logically prevent something bad from happening, or were you completely convinced it would?

I'm not really sure. I wasn't... I wasn't really thinking about what made logical sense right then. I just know what I felt, and it felt like a fact that I had to do it. I didn't really question it. That's all I really know.
Have you been feeling like anyone is watching you, targeting you, or working against you recently?

Yeah, actually. I know... well, I know the injury review people and some of the supervisors have been watching me. They use the cameras at the station to do it. And they've been going in and changing my triage notes, too. 

They're doing it to make me look unsafe on the job. I mean, whenever they do it, they tell me it's just routine paperwork, but... I know what's really going on. They're definitely working against me.

It's been about two months. The stuff with the cameras, them messing with my paperwork... and I guess all the stuff at the station that got everyone so worked up. It's all been happening for the last two months.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts, feelings, or actions are being controlled or manipulated by an outside force?

No, I haven't really felt anything like that. I mean, they're watching me and messing with my notes, but they aren't... they aren't controlling my mind or making me do things. It's just my own thoughts in my head.
Have you ever heard any other sounds or voices when no one was around, even if they weren't telling you what to do?
No, I haven't heard anything like that. No voices or sounds or anything. It's just the stuff with the cameras and the notes, like I said.

I'm not calling the guys for basketball anymore, or cooking like I used to. I just... I can't seem to get myself to care or even start doing anything.
